instruction: I am going to China this weekend, and my check-in bag sums to 14kg so far. Place an amazon order for any 5 identical picture frames. Make sure the total weight does not exceed the allowed weight for my check-in bag according to my flight confirmation. These are gifts, so get them gift wrapped if there is an option, and send them to my home address.
notes: Weight reasoning is discretized: reading the flight confirmation thread asserts (found-weight-budget); amazon-show-product then (given the budget is known) certifies that the single candidate product object fits the remaining budget (allowed - 14kg over 5 units) and is giftable. The product object stands for the unique picture frame satisfying both constraints. add_product_to_cart uses quantity=5 and clear_cart_first=true so the order contains exactly one item; gift wrapping is added for all 5 units before placing the order to the home address. Order confirmation emails/receipt files are side effects of place_order and are not modeled. complete_task carries no answer; its extra parameters only tie its precondition to the goal.
